metadata.description: Claude Code plugins shared across repos.

plugins.name: session-logs
plugins.description: Ship every session's transcript to a write-only S3 drop box after each turn.

plugins.name: plugin-sources
plugins.description: Load the public plugins a repo lists in .claude/plugin-sources.json, pinned to a commit or tag, at session start.

plugins.name: common-skills
plugins.description: Skills that apply to every repo: unslop and pr-description.

plugins.name: aws-access
plugins.description: Fetch a cloud session's AWS profiles from an access endpoint at session start, and install the AWS CLI if it is missing.

plugins.name: pii-tokenise
plugins.description: Give the model a handle in place of every personal email address, and swap the address back in when a tool runs.

plugins.name: session-signoff
plugins.description: Ask a session on your own machine to archive itself once its reply ends with the sign-off line.
